```yaml
name: E2E Portals

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/e2e-portals.yml
      - tests/e2e/**

jobs:
  e2e-portals:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Rust setup & caching
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rustfmt, clippy
          cache: true

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache Cargo git index
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Install utilities
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Install netcat and jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y netcat jq

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Build binaries
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Build tavern
        run: cargo build --release --bin tavern

      - name: Build imixv2
        run: cargo build --release --bin imixv2

      - name: Build socks5 proxy
        run: cargo build --release --bin socks5

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Start infrastructure
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Start tavern
        run: |
          ./target/release/tavern --config config/tavern.yaml > tavern.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > tavern.pid
        env:
          RUST_LOG: debug

      - name: Start imix
        run: |
          ./target/release/imixv2 --config config/imix.yaml > imix.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > imix.pid
        env:
          RUST_LOG: debug

      - name: Wait for services to be ready
        run: |
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if nc -z localhost 8080 && nc -z localhost 9090; then
              echo "Services are up"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 2
          done
          echo "Services did not start in time"
          exit 1

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Playwright setup & test
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Run Playwright test
        run: npx playwright test tests/e2e/tests/portal.spec.ts

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Retrieve portal ID via GraphQL
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Retrieve Portal ID
        id: portal
        run: |
          ID=$(curl -s -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"query":"{ portal(name: \"SOCKS5 Relay\") { id } }"}' \
            http://localhost:8080/graphql | jq -r '.data.portal.id')
          echo "portal_id=$ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Start SOCKS5 proxy
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Start socks5 proxy
        run: |
          ./target/release/socks5 --portal-id ${{ steps.portal.outputs.portal_id }} > socks5.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > socks5.pid

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Start mock HTTP server
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Start mock HTTP server
        run: |
          python3 -m http.server 8000 > httpserver.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > httpserver.pid

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Verify data integrity
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Transfer file via proxy and verify checksum
        run: |
          echo "Hello world" > testfile.txt
          curl -x socks5h://localhost:1080 http://localhost:8000/testfile.txt -o /tmp/received.txt
          sha256sum testfile.txt > original.sha256
          sha256sum /tmp/received.txt > received.sha256
          diff original.sha256 received.sha256

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Cleanup
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Cleanup processes
        if: always()
        run: |
          kill $(cat tavern.pid) || true
          kill $(cat imix.pid) || true
          kill $(cat socks5.pid) || true
          kill $(cat httpserver.pid) || true
```
